is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.s. (page 2, 4).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports genotyping for kdr (L1014F) and ace-1R (G119S) (page 4, 9).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 6 provides allele frequencies with sample sizes (n), and Table 7 provides genotype survival counts (live/total) (page 9).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from experimental huts in Valley du Kou, Burkina Faso (page 2, 4).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an experimental hut trial study.

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a primary experimental hut trial study with new collections.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data is provided in the tables within the main text.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the efficacy of pirimiphos-methyl treated durable wall linings (DL) and net wall hangings (NWH) against pyrethroid-resistant Anopheles gambiae in experimental huts in Burkina Faso. It also investigated the selection of kdr and ace-1R resistance markers in mosquitoes collected from these huts.
